text: たのむ　から　あっち　いってくれ！

structure.jp: あっち　いってくれ！

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form verb is a blunt, rough way to tell someone to do something for you. いってくれ = 'go, will you'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a verb means 'because' or 'so'. With たのむ it is a set way to plead before asking for something. たのむ　から = 'I'm begging you, so'.
